territories.name: Turkmenistan
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Turkmenistan levies a value added tax of its own under its Tax Code: article 103 sets it at 15 per cent, article 105 zero-rates the operations it lists, article 106 exempts the operations it lists, and article 111 has the taxpayer file the return by the 20th of the month following the reporting month and pay by the 25th.
